name: Due List Agent
summary: Demonstrated live at NBAA-BACE this week. The agent reads a due list from an uploaded PDF or a connected maintenance tracking system, extracts the upcoming tasks, identifies parts, estimates labor and generates a work order or quote with the supporting documentation, ready for review.
paragraphs: Demonstrated live at NBAA-BACE this week. The agent reads a due list from an uploaded PDF or a connected maintenance tracking system, extracts the upcoming tasks, identifies parts, estimates labor and generates a work order or quote with the supporting documentation, ready for review.
whyItMatters: Turning a customer's due list into a quote is hours of retyping for most repair stations, and the shop that quotes first often wins the work. Feed it a due list you have already quoted by hand and compare the tasks, parts and hours line by line.
